title: 🚀 Homarr v2 public beta is here! Join the testing
body:
🚀 Homarr v2 public beta is here!

We are very excited to introduce and share the biggest Homarr update ever, and we are looking for your help to test and break it before the official release. > [!WARNING] > Please **back up your current Homarr database** first and use a **new volume**. ## Main changes | Feature | What it brings | | ---------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | **Custom Widgets V2** | A complete rewrite, can be used to build a custom widget for that shiny new tool added to your selfhosted arsenal | | **Community Workshop** | Create, upload, download, install, update, and share custom widgets and CSS with the community | | **Performance** | ~30% less RAM (hopefully), faster widget rendering, queries and caching, fewer repeated requests, much better browser performance for most widgets | | **New drag and drop** | Complete rework, responsive layouts, containers. **Sidebars are back** + no need to create mobile boards anymore | | **Onboarding** | Completely re-worked to be much better and sexier | | **Advanced widgets** | New mode, press shift on widgets for more details | | **Assistant** | In the search bar for web searches, Homarr actions, custom CSS, creating widgets and much more | > [!NOTE] > The Assistant ships with a **"homarr provider"** that is free (and will never offer any paid plans). We use only ZDR providers, the provider is open-source, and there is **no prompt or response logging** — we're not selling your data. ## Screenshots | | | | | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | ![Dashboard overview](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d2a52fcd-18c1-4a7b-aa9b-2f64c78e12e2) | ![Custom widgets](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/54a922b4-9c73-44d1-83cf-5360f2ec5e60) | ![Workshop](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9e205a56-e537-4636-ab5f-99b5b8a0ab70) | | ![Onboarding](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a6727a27-57d3-4d51-8abc-4b579f9d6ab8) | ![Assistant](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fa0112a7-7838-42eb-8b3b-050ba25aaa6b) | ![Drag and drop](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ad56ec34-61c7-469e-bad3-8e0588b7ca26) | | ![Advanced widgets](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/18b77141-12f8-4856-9341-28be71746a21) | ![Mobile](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a70002eb-18c5-4e51-86ec-c1961e67cd00) | | ## Links | | | | ---------------------- | -------------------------------------- | | **Live demo** | https://app-v2.preview.homarr.dev/ | | **Community Workshop** | https://v2.preview.homarr.dev/workshop | ## Try it out > [!TIP] > Use a **new volume** just in case something goes wrong. Or at the very least go to management -> backup and save a backup of your current config before switching to v2 as it is **beta software** ### Docker Run (recommended) ```bash docker run -d --rm --name homarr-v2 -p 7575:7575 -v homarr-v2:/appdata \ -e SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY="c2d5f85f7d3968d20fcea2a5df26d0f8545cd75bac3a31976a5dce4238f5ad80" \ -e WORKSHOP_API_URL="https://v2.preview.homarr.dev" \ ghcr.io/homarr-labs/homarr-test:v2 ```
Docker Compose ```yaml services: homarr: image: ghcr.io/homarr-labs/homarr-test:v2 ports: - "7575:7575" volumes: - homarr-v2:/appdata environment: SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY: c2d5f85f7d3968d20fcea2a5df26d0f8545cd75bac3a31976a5dce4238f5ad80 WORKSHOP_API_URL: https://v2.preview.homarr.dev volumes: homarr-v2: ``` ```bash docker compose up -d ```
## Share your feedback Please share your thoughts, bugs you find, frustrations and your overall experience, tell us about your use cases for the assistant and what custom widgets you are making. We'd love to see your custom CSS & widgets on the workshop! ❤️

I've been playing with the v2 for a day now and here are some pros, cons and bugs (not much!)

1. Pros:
- The biggest one:  The widget scale dynamically better on smaller screens than before. I have a Samsung tablet that I'm using as a dashboard and with Homarr V1 some of the widgets had to be scrolled horizontally to be able to see everything or to edit something (ie. Docker stats table). It is no longer the case as everything is now properly scaled. 
- the Ctrl+click that allows to move widgets to containers with a really nice sound "bop"
- New great widgets (AQI, more days for the weather widget, AI, Stock price)
- The AI widget setup was painless. I was able to connect to my local Ollama and ask questions
- When creating a new widget you have a preview pane on the left where you can adjust the size of the widget before adding it to the dashboard.
- Right click on widgets (I don't remember if it was possible to do in homarr v1)
- When there's an error in a widget the ability to click on view log and being sent to the exact timestamp of the log where the error occurred "
--- Widget reported an error around this time ---"

2. Cons/Bugs:
- When refreshing the WebUI, the widgets take 5x as much time to refresh as in v1. It's a 5s vs 72s. wait in Homarr v2. The widgets refresh fine on their own but not when the whole webpage is refreshed. 
- The Date and time widget doesnt show the world clocks.
- Media releases widget doesnt work (but it's not important)

3. Suggestions:
- To have buttons to start-stop-pause the dockers on the Docker stats table widget. To not have to click the 3 dots next to the container. 

4. Next steps:
- to play with the Layout section 
- To create a custom widget (scrutiny to check HDD health and Media transcode widget for Fileflows)

I really enjoy the V2, really good job!

Small heads-up on the public preview: the demo login advertised on the sign-in page does not work.

On https://app-v2.preview.homarr.dev/auth/login the banner says *"Demo mode is enabled. Sign in with username `demo` and password `demo`"*, but those credentials are rejected — the UI shows **"Login failed / Your login failed"**.

What I see in the network log (checked 2026-09-07, ~18:35 CEST, from two different clients/IPs):

- `POST /api/auth/callback/credentials` → HTTP 200 (no error status)
- `GET /api/auth/session` → still empty, no session is established

So it fails silently server-side rather than returning an auth error. Looks like the seeded demo user is missing or the credentials provider isn't wired up on that deployment — anyone who wants to try the beta without self-hosting is currently locked out.
